summary: Static keyword co-occurrence in Baileys fork; no traced installer harm
details: Package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. Static pattern matched on keyword co-occurrence ("ping", "GET", "id") in lib/Utils/generics.js, which is a shared shape with ordinary HTTP/protocol code in a messaging library. No hardcoded attacker C2, no credential-store or home-directory scanning, no install-time fetch-and-execute, no lifecycle scripts performing network exfiltration were identified in the shipped code. The specific keyword co-occurrence flagged does not, by itself, demonstrate exfiltration of installer-side data to an attacker-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
